notes.title: Luffi has a release date and it's free!
notes.notes: [p]Soon we'll mark the end of a learning journey for myself and the team. Last year, we embarked on a journey to learn new skills and discover a new engine "Unreal". [/p][p][/p][p]Through learning blender modelling, sculpting, texturing, rigging, animating, niagra vfx, shader graph, unreal blueprints, sound design and scored by the ever wonderful Epoch Music crew, this project represents the sum total of our new found abilities![/p][p][/p][p]So I'm really excited to be able to share it with you all and at no cost at all. Please enjoy the simple and sweet story of Luffi finding his way home. It's heartfelt and we think you'll enjoy each last drop of the short adventure![/p]
